```{r}
#| include: false

## Get involved page ("Night and Day" design): navy hero with five audience
## cards (also the page's jump list) across the night/day line, then one day
## band per audience: #participate (studies), #partner (lived experience),
## #study (students), #collaborate and #work. Every section stays on the page
## even when nothing is open: it then shows a fallback line. Everything that
## goes out of date (studies, partner roles, student projects, programs and
## their Monash links, jobs) is in data/join.yml; the prose is here.
## Built from Pandoc markdown that the chunks below cat(); styles are in
## styles/bml.scss and styles/bml-join.scss. The page has no title (so no
## title banner): the hero's .bml-display is the page heading. Email buttons
## use mailtoUrl() with a subject per audience.

## load packages and setup
source("package_setup.R", echo = FALSE)

info <- yaml::read_yaml("data/join.yml")
today <- Sys.Date()

## TRUE when a field in the data file has something in it (empty, ~, [] and a
## list of empty items are all "nothing")
has <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) return(FALSE)
  if (is.list(x)) return(any(vapply(x, has, TRUE)))
  any(!is.na(x) & nzchar(trimws(as.character(x))))
}

## a list from the data file as text items, empty ones dropped. YAML reads an
## unquoted "- Age: 18 or older" as a key and a value, so it is put back
## together here.
listItems <- function(x) {
  vapply(Filter(has, x), function(v) {
    if (is.list(v)) paste0(names(v), ": ", unlist(v), collapse = "; ") else as.character(v)
  }, "")
}

## Stop the build with a clear message when an entry is missing a field the
## page needs (its card would otherwise vanish without a word).
need <- function(xs, fields, what) {
  for (x in xs) {
    miss <- fields[!vapply(fields, function(f) has(x[[f]]), TRUE)]
    if (length(miss) > 0) {
      name <- if (has(x$title)) x$title else if (has(x$name)) x$name else ""
      stop(sprintf("data/join.yml: %s%s has no %s", what,
                   if (nzchar(name)) sprintf(" \"%s\"", name) else "",
                   paste(miss, collapse = ", ")), call. = FALSE)
    }
  }
}
need(info$studies, c("title", "status", "summary"), "study")
need(info$partner_roles, c("title", "status", "summary"), "partner role")
need(info$student_projects, c("title", "text"), "project theme")
need(info$programs, c("id", "name", "length", "links", "subject"), "program")
for (p in info$programs) need(p$links, c("text", "url"), sprintf("a link of %s", p$name))
need(info$roles, c("title", "summary", "url"), "role")

## "Tuesday 1 December 2026" (a role's closing date)
longDate <- function(d) sprintf("%s %s", weekdays(d), shortDate(d))
shortDate <- function(d) sprintf("%d %s", as.integer(format(d, "%d")), format(d, "%B %Y"))

## "Opening in 2027" -> "opening in 2027", for "SleepSteps: opening in 2027";
## a word in capitals ("HREC ...") stays as it is
lowerFirst <- function(x) sub("^([A-Z])(?=[a-z])", "\\L\\1", x, perl = TRUE)

## A study's or partner role's status: recruiting, opening-soon or closed
## ("Opening soon" and "opening_soon" work too). Anything else is noted in the
## render log and the entry is hidden.
statusOf <- function(x) {
  st <- tolower(gsub("[ _]+", "-", trimws(as.character(x$status))))
  if (!st %in% c("recruiting", "opening-soon", "closed")) {
    cat(sprintf("join.qmd: data/join.yml: \"%s\" has unknown status \"%s\" (use recruiting, opening-soon or closed), so it is hidden.\n",
                x$title, x$status), file = stderr())
  }
  st
}
openOnly <- function(xs) {
  xs <- lapply(xs, function(x) { x$status <- statusOf(x); x })
  Filter(function(x) x$status %in% c("recruiting", "opening-soon"), xs)
}

## the status as words (never colour alone)
statusLabel <- function(x) {
  if (has(x$status_label)) x$status_label
  else if (identical(x$status, "recruiting")) "Recruiting now" else "Opening soon"
}
statusMd <- function(x) {
  sprintf("[%s]{.bml-status%s}", statusLabel(x),
          if (identical(x$status, "recruiting")) " .bml-status-open" else "")
}

studies <- openOnly(info$studies)
partnerRoles <- openOnly(info$partner_roles)
roles <- Filter(function(r) !has(r$closes) || as.Date(r$closes) >= today, info$roles)


## ---- the hero cards' status lines (Work with us has its line as its text) ----
waysStatus <- list(
  participate = if (length(studies) > 0) {
    s <- studies[[1]]
    if (has(s$teaser)) s$teaser else sprintf("%s: %s", s$title, lowerFirst(statusLabel(s)))
  } else "No studies open right now",
  partner = if (length(partnerRoles) > 0) {
    r <- partnerRoles[[1]]
    sprintf("%s: %s", if (has(r$short)) r$short else r$title, lowerFirst(statusLabel(r)))
  } else "We'd love to hear from you",
  study = "Talk to us before you apply",
  collaborate = "Visiting researchers welcome",
  work = if (length(roles) == 0) "Not recruiting right now." else
    sprintf("%d %s open.", length(roles), if (length(roles) == 1) "role" else "roles"))

## ---- markdown pieces (text from the data file is Markdown, used as is) ----

## a study's card: title and status, what it is, the participant details the
## HREC approved (each only once filled in), then how to sign up
studyCard <- function(s) {
  details <- c(
    if (has(s$who_can_take_part)) paste0("**Who can take part**\n\n",
      paste0("- ", listItems(s$who_can_take_part), collapse = "\n")),
    if (has(s$what_is_involved)) paste0("**What's involved:** ", s$what_is_involved),
    if (has(s$reimbursement)) paste0("**Thank-you payment:** ", s$reimbursement))
  reg <- s$registration
  meta <- c(
    if (has(s$ethics)) sprintf("Ethics approval: %s.", s$ethics),
    if (has(reg)) {
      what <- paste(c(if (has(reg$registry)) reg$registry, if (has(reg$id)) reg$id), collapse = " ")
      if (has(reg$url)) sprintf("Trial registration: [%s](%s).", what, reg$url)
      else sprintf("Trial registration: %s.", what)
    })
  recruiting <- identical(s$status, "recruiting")
  button <- if (recruiting) "Register your interest" else "Notify me when it opens"
  ## `signup: no` or `false` reads as FALSE, which means no sign-up too
  signup <- if (is.character(s$signup) && has(s$signup)) trimws(s$signup) else ""
  action <- if (!nzchar(signup)) {
    "[Check back soon.]{.bml-meta}"
  } else if (identical(tolower(signup), "email")) {
    sprintf("[%s](%s){.bml-btn}", button, mailtoUrl(sprintf("%s: %s", s$title,
      if (recruiting) "register interest" else "notify me")))
  } else {
    sprintf("[%s](%s){.bml-btn}", button, signup)
  }
  more <- if (has(s$info_url)) sprintf(
    ' [More about %s [→]{aria-hidden="true"}](%s){.bml-link}', s$title, s$info_url) else ""
  sprintf('
::: {.bml-card .bml-study}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### %s

%s
:::

%s

%s

%s

::: {.bml-actions}
%s%s
:::
:::
', s$title, statusMd(s), s$summary, paste(details, collapse = "\n\n"),
    if (length(meta)) sprintf("[%s]{.bml-meta}", paste(meta, collapse = " ")) else "",
    action, more)
}

## an open partner role (e.g. an advisory committee); people get in touch
## with the section's "Email us" button, just above it
partnerCard <- function(r) {
  sprintf('
::: {.g-col-12 .bml-card .bml-opening}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### %s

%s
:::

%s

If you\'re interested, use the **Email us** button above.
:::
', r$title, statusMd(r), r$summary)
}

## official links as Markdown, one after another: "[text](url)<sep>[text](url)"
linksMd <- function(x, sep) {
  paste(sprintf("[%s](%s)", vapply(x, `[[`, "", "text"), vapply(x, `[[`, "", "url")),
        collapse = sep)
}

## a program's row in the programs table (#<id>): its name, two facts as a
## definition list (Length, and Monash's own pages for dates, entry and how to
## apply: the page lists no dates), and an email button
programRow <- function(p) {
  sprintf('
::: {#%s .bml-row .bml-program-row}
[%s]{.bml-row-label}

::: {.bml-facts}
Length
: %s

More information
: %s
:::

::: {.bml-program-action}
[Email us](%s){.bml-btn aria-label="Email us about %s"}
:::
:::
', p$id, p$name, p$length, linksMd(p$links, sep = "\\\n    "),
    mailtoUrl(p$subject), attrEscape(p$name))
}

## an open paid role
roleCard <- function(r) {
  sprintf('
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .bml-card .bml-role}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### %s
:::

%s

%s

[Read the ad and apply](%s){.bml-btn aria-label="Read the ad and apply: %s"}
:::
', r$title, r$summary,
    if (has(r$closes)) sprintf("[Applications close %s.]{.bml-meta}", longDate(as.Date(r$closes))) else "",
    r$url, attrEscape(r$title))
}
```

### In Australia and need support now? {#need-support}

If you are struggling, talk to your GP or treating team.

- [Cancer Council](https://www.cancer.org.au/support-and-services/cancer-council-13-11-20): [13\ 11\ 20](tel:131120), Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm
- [Lifeline](https://www.lifeline.org.au/), any time: [13\ 11\ 14](tel:131114), or text [0477\ 13\ 11\ 14](sms:0477131114)
- In an emergency, call [000](tel:000).
:::
:::

::: {#take-part .grid .bml-gap-lg .bml-path-head}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5}
## Share your lived experience
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}
Research works better when people with lived experience help shape it: *nothing about the community without the community*. We are looking for people who have, or have had, cancer, and for family members and carers, to work with us.

This is different from taking part in a study. As a partner, you help us plan and run the research.

::: {.bml-actions}
[Email us](`r mailtoUrl("Lived experience")`){.bml-btn aria-label="Email us about being a lived experience partner"}
:::
:::
:::

::: {.grid .bml-path-body}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## open partner roles first, or the fallback line
if (length(partnerRoles) == 0) {
  cat("\n::: {.g-col-12 .bml-card .bml-empty}\nNo set roles are open right now, but we'd still love to hear from you.\n:::\n")
} else {
  for (r in partnerRoles) cat(partnerCard(r))
}
```

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### What you could do {#what-you-could-do}
:::

- Join an advisory committee for one of our studies.
- Review videos, websites and information sheets before they reach participants.
- Help design new studies and choose which questions matter most.
- Help share what we find with the community.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### What we offer {#what-we-offer}
:::

- You'll be paid for your time, and we cover reasonable expenses.
- You don't need any research experience. Your experience is the expertise.
- You'll have a named contact, a plain-language introduction and meetings that fit around your health and commitments.
- You can step back at any time.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### Community and cancer support organisations {#organisations}
:::

We partner with organisations on co-design, reaching participants and sharing results. We'd love to hear from you.

[Email us about a partnership [→]{aria-hidden="true"}](`r mailtoUrl("Community partnership")`){.bml-link}
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-6 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### New to research partnership? {#partner-resources}
:::

- [Consumer Involvement Pack (PDF)](https://involvementtoolkit.clinicaltrialsalliance.org.au/media/z2odqoly/cip-final.pdf): what being involved in health research means and what to expect, from the Australian Clinical Trials Alliance.
- [Consumers in Research](https://www.cancer.org.au/support-and-services/cancer-resources-and-information/elearning/consumers-in-research-training): a free online course from Cancer Council Australia, in four short modules.
- [Research Say](https://mu-researchsay.mysocialpinpoint.com.au/): join the Monash University Clinical Trials Centre's community and have a say in health research.
- [Statement on Consumer and Community Involvement in Health and Medical Research](https://www.nhmrc.gov.au/about-us/publications/statement-consumer-and-community-involvement-health-medical-research): NHMRC and the Consumers Health Forum of Australia, 2026.
:::
:::
:::

::: {#study .column-screen .bml-band .bml-path}
::: {.grid .bml-gap-lg .bml-path-head}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5}
## Study with us
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}
We supervise Honours, Master of Clinical Psychology and PhD students in the School of Psychological Sciences at Monash University. Projects can be research-only or include supervised clinical training in sleep interventions.
:::
:::

::: {.grid .bml-path-body}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### What supervision looks like {#supervision}
:::

- Weekly one-on-one supervision for Masters and PhD students
- Projects designed with you to finish on time
- Authorship agreed upfront
- Workload negotiated with you, not demanded

Your wellbeing comes before project outcomes. Read our [ethics and values](ethics_values.qmd).
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### Current project themes {#projects}
:::

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

## project themes from the data file, each with an optional funding line
## (a block below the theme), or a line inviting ideas when the list is empty
if (!has(info$student_projects)) {
  cat("Email us to talk about a project that fits your interests.\n")
} else {
  cat(paste(vapply(info$student_projects, function(x) sprintf(
    "- **%s:** %s%s", x$title, x$text,
    if (has(x$funding)) sprintf(" [%s]{.bml-meta}", x$funding) else ""), ""),
    collapse = "\n"), "\n")
}
```
:::

::: {.grid .bml-path-body}
::: {.g-col-12 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### PhD scholarships {#phd-scholarships}
:::

::: {.bml-cols-2}
**International applicants.** To be competitive for Monash University's international scholarships, in our experience you need excellent grades, a degree from a highly ranked university and a first-author peer-reviewed publication.

**Domestic applicants.** We encourage everyone to express interest: domestic scholarships are usually less competitive.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7 .bml-card}
::: {.bml-card-top}
### What to send {#what-to-send}
:::

Use the email button for your program (it fills in the subject line), and include:

- which program and start year you're aiming for
- two or three sentences on which project or topic interests you, and why
- your CV
- your transcript (unofficial is fine)

For a PhD, please also include:

- English language test results, if applicable (for example, IELTS)
- any research experience (a writing sample is optional)

Please get in touch 6 to 8 weeks before the relevant deadline.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-5 .bml-card .bml-night}
[Everyone is welcome]{.bml-eyebrow}

We especially encourage applications from people historically under-represented in the health sciences. If something is making it hard to apply, contact us to talk about it.

[Email us](`r mailtoUrl("Study enquiry")`){.bml-btn aria-label="Email us about studying with us"}
:::
:::

:::

## Collaborate with us
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-lg-7}

::: {.bml-actions}

### Areas we work in {#areas}
:::

- **Sleep and insomnia:** CBT-I, stepped and digital care
- **Cancer and psycho-oncology**
- **Emotion regulation, coping and stress**
- **Methods:** daily diary and EMA studies, intensive longitudinal and multilevel modelling, 24-hour time use and compositional data analysis, wearables, and individual participant data and precision modelling
